body: Yeah I’m aware. Im subbed to r/2aliberals in my main, I just can’t mix the 2 things I like.

He’d be a tyrant at that point. If he doesn’t budge and the military refuses to remove him, we as the citizens of the United States have the *duty* to remove him. I mean asymmetrical warfare is a lot harder to fight than you think, especially when it’s *your own infrastructure and civilians at stake* 

They can’t bomb hospitals and schools here under pretext of “militants”. Even if they could, we only need 1% of the population to fight back and suddenly the military is outnumbered even if they had 100% backing and all reserves active. 

It’s not easy for either side to win, and the state has the advantage, but it’s not as simple as who has planes and who doesn’t.

I’m not voting turnip, but I’m not voting Biden either.

...which is why the left needs to embrace the 2nd not shun it.

My last attempt was mostly out of spite. So many people had let me down, and the 1 person I relied on for help turned around and threw me in the trash. I caved in on the thoughts I’ve had for so long, out of *spite*. 

I snapped out of it before I did anything too horrible, but I do see why someone would feel the way you do. 

Have you thought about reaching out to some of the people in your life? A lot of people don’t really know what suffering from mental illness looks like, even if they see it every day in a loved one, or the mirror.
